name: FoundersDB
summary: Case-study database of profitable SaaS and apps with revenue figures, growth tactics and P&L details from real founders.
description: A database of 1,500+ startup case studies with verified revenue data ($25K average), growth tactics, pricing strategy and real P&L data, browsable by category (SaaS, AI tools, no-code, agency) and by app — Outrank.so ($250k+ MRR), Jenni.ai, Cal AI, Vonu and others — with founder stories such as Marc Lou, David Park and Tibo. Full access requires an account; the site also offers a newsletter.
